title: Require Research SDK External Neutrality
forbids: Template packages outside the research SDK importing or re-exporting Effect-bearing research SDK subpaths
why: Only neutral decoded data may cross from the research SDK into unrelated Template packages; Effect services remain package-local and lane consumers bind through an immutable artifact.
remediate: Import @rawr/research-sdk or @rawr/research-sdk/contracts, or move the Effect-bearing integration into the research SDK or its owner-local lane consumer.
message: Unrelated Template packages may consume only neutral research SDK surfaces.
